$comment: Tokens that MUST appear verbatim in EVERY locale. scripts/validate-translations.ts enforces: for any message whose English value contains one of these, the translation must contain the same token unchanged. Scope is deliberately narrow — only the brand, CSS identifiers, product/framework/org names, acronyms, and a contributor name. Coined/math terms (squircle, superellipse, clothoid, Euler, Bézier) are NOT enforced here: every target language has a natural rendering for them (native math term, transliteration, or capitalization), so they are handled per-locale via i18n/glossary.json and native review instead.
